    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuthenticationMenu
    Handles authentication-related user interface interactions.
    Client
    Represents a client with an ID, full name, and associated phone numbers.
    ClientsDao
    Data access interface for client persistence operations.
    ClientsJsonDao
    JSON implementation of ClientsDao using Gson for persistence.
    ClientsManager
    Handles client authentication and registration logic.
    main
    Entry point of the application.
    MenuController
    Controls the application flow and user interactions between UI and business logic.
    PhoneNumber
    Represents a phone number with a country prefix and number.
    Product
    Represents a product with its details and associated suppliers.
    ProductForSale
    Represents a product available for sale, including price and stock.
    ProductsDao
    Data access interface for products.
    ProductsJsonDao
    JSON implementation of ProductsDao using Gson for persistence.
    ProductsManager
    Handles product-related business operations.
    Provider
    Represents a provider company and its associated products.
    ProvidersDao
    Data access interface for provider persistence operations.
    ProvidersJsonDao
    JSON implementation of ProvidersDao using Gson for persistence.
    ProvidersManager
    Handles provider-related business operations.
    Sale
    Represents a sale transaction between a client and a product.
    SalesCsvDao
    CSV implementation of SalesDao using OpenCSV for persistence.
    SalesDao
    Data access interface for sales persistence operations.
    SalesManager
    Handles sales-related business operations.
    ShoppingCart
    Represents a shopping cart containing products and VAT information.
    ShoppingCartManager
    Manages shopping cart operations such as adding products, checkout, and provider lookup.
    UIMainMenu
    Handles all main menu UI interactions for the application.
